text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — ran profiling against canary yesterday; kernel selector is frequently falling back to generic kernel on medium seqs and we're seeing token latency spikes. Dashboard gaps: no per-route kernel_choice breakdown or KV prefetch hit rate per model. Can we add panels? :frowning_face:
Maria Lopez: saw that too, spikes line up with sm_occupancy drops and power climb on node g4-58. Do we have Prometheus metrics exposed for kernel_choice? There's only a histogram `kernel_exec_ms` but not label for selector.
Tom W: we can export `kernel_selector` label from runtime runcalls. low-cost change. Also add `batch_fill_ratio` gauge and `kv_prefetch_hits_total` counter. I'll draft patch.
Priya Nair: if we add kernel_choice label, make sure cardinality stays low — use enums: fast, fallback, fallback_smallbatch. Also include route and model_version labels for per-route KPIs.
Jin Park: +1. For Grafana panels, want token-level waterfall: break down queue_time, kernel_time, kv_lookup_time, memcpy_time. Current token latency is opaque.
Alex Chen: example PromQLs?
Tom W: paste code block
```
# per-route kernel choice breakdown
sum by (route,kernel_selector) (increase(kernel_exec_count[5m]))

# kv prefetch hit rate
increase(kv_prefetch_hits_total[5m]) / ignoring(instance) group_left sum(increase(kv_prefetch_requests_total[5m]))

# sm occupancy avg per GPU
avg_over_time(nvidia_sm_occupancy_percent[10m])
```
Maria Lopez: can we also add a panel correlating sm_occupancy vs token_latency_95? scatter or heatmap.
Priya Nair: Also annotate deploys — last deploy at 1860009000 looked correlated. ops-bot can add annotations.
ops-bot: annotation added for deploy 1860009000 by @deploy-bot :white_check_mark:
telemetry-bot: added metric kernel_selector (label), kv_prefetch_{hits,requests} counters, batch_fill_ratio gauge to scrape config — rolling out to canary.
Alex Chen: awesome. Timeline? we need dashboards in staging for Monday.
Tom W: patch in review, dashboard json incoming — will add panels: per-route kernel_choice, kv prefetch hit rate, token waterfall, sm/vram/power heatmap by MIG slice. keep panels lightweight.
Maria Lopez: make sure panelling across MIG slices uses label 'mig_slice' to avoid heavy cardinality.
Jin Park: small nit — when plotting power use avg vs max per 1m to catch spikes.
Priya Nair: also request alert: if fallback kernel_rate > 5% and p95 token latency increases > 15% over baseline, fire alert.
Alex Chen: will add alert runbook snippet.
Tom W: dropping dashboard link when ready :link:
Maria Lopez: thanks team :rocket:
